name: blind-rce
description: A Python-based program for Time-based/Blind Remote Code Execution (RCE). The main objective of this program is to extract the data that is not visible and/or not returned in the response of vulnerable target. It uses time-based techniques by sending a payload to the target with a command specified and then waiting for its response.
